name: The People's Militia
summary: At Sentinel Hill, Gryan Stoutmantle puts the People's Militia to the test against outlaws in Westfall's northern fields and mines. Local volunteers defend the region from the Defias Brotherhood while Stormwind's throne is distracted and its army absent.

sections.title: The Price of Peace
sections.body: Gryan Stoutmantle founded the People's Militia, and he does not take just anyone. Anyone seeking its badge must prove they can fight and protect innocent settlers. He calls for decisive action to reclaim Westfall from the outlaws, vagrants, and thieves overrunning the region.

sections.title: Clearing the Breadbasket
sections.body: Before Gryan Stoutmantle trusts new recruits with deeper operations, he sends them against Defias forces near the northern homesteads. Defias Trappers and Smugglers work openly near Jangolode Mine, Molsen Farm, and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Patch. They pillage stores and ambush travelers. Driving them out disrupts their foraging and shows Stoutmantle's scouts you have the grit for a long fight against crime.

faq.answer: The People's Militia is a volunteer army organized by Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill. Local farmers, veterans, and commoners formed its ranks to defend Westfall from the Defias Brotherhood while Stormwind's royal army has refused or failed to garrison the region.

faq.q: Why isn't Stormwind sending its royal army?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing, Stormwind's noble House of Nobles and council leadership have focused the kingdom's resources elsewhere. Outlying rural territories like Westfall are left to fend for themselves against rising outlaw bands.

faq.q: Where can I find Defias Trappers and Smugglers?
faq.answer: Defias Trappers and Smugglers work across northern Westfall, especially around Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm, Molsen Farm, and the entrance to Jangolode Mine.

Gryan Stoutmantle is a seasoned veteran who commands the People's Militia at Sentinel Hill. He rallies volunteers to defend Westfall's settlers, drive out the Defias Brotherhood, and restore order to the countryside.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to more militia assignments?
faq.answer: Yes. This opening trial leads to further duties for successful volunteers, who take on increasingly dangerous ranks of the Defias Brotherhood across Westfall's plains.

faq.q: What is happening at Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood drove the Furlbrows from their homestead and took control of their farmland. Outlaws and scavengers now pillage the fields and terrorize the northern roads.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you see the kingdom's divide: Stormwind's nobility stays behind the capital's walls while common settlers defend Westfall from ruin.
As a human of the kingdom, you see working families and generations of farmers suffer under bandit attacks while royal authorities look away.
As a paladin, you protect the defenseless and bring judgment to outlaws who prey on the vulnerable.
